inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: There’s no reason election day should become a sanctuary from ordinary law enforcement. Tom Homan hasn’t ruled out enforcement at polling places, and that alone shouldn’t be turned into proof of some sinister plot. The real priority is orderly, lawful elections—and clear guidance from the administration so citizens know what to expect. Democrats’ alarm risks making basic enforcement sound illegitimate, which is exactly the wrong message if we want public trust and respect for the law.
